# Version 4.156.0
> **Native rendering and platform modernization** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 brings Skia m156, GTK4 GPU drawing, and updated platform integrations. The cumulative preview line restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery, improves Android frame pacing and Windows resource lifetimes, and aligns WebAssembly assets with .NET 11. Review the Apple, Tizen, Uno, and input-validation migration guidance before upgrading; changes after Preview 1 are not included in that shipment.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require native deployment targets of macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15, superseding the earlier macOS 11/iOS 14 floors in this line. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, retaining any higher managed or framework requirements. The newer floors support Xcode 27 builds; .NET 9 targets remain available. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Move Tizen applications to Tizen 10** — The new native packages target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support Tizen 10 on x64 and arm64, not Tizen 8/9 or 32-bit targets. Upgrade application frameworks and deployment requirements; source builds require Tizen 10 and GCC 14.2. Tizen 10 device loading was not established by the recorded build validation. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Upgrade Uno integrations to Uno Platform 7** — The non-Windows Uno views now require .NET 10 and Uno Platform 7's unified renderer. Upgrade Uno applications and use the .NET SDK WebAssembly build path: the separate native-renderer runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell integration are retired. Uno.Sdk supplies platform native assets; Windows package facades continue to use SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Choose the appropriate Uno canvas** — On non-Windows Uno targets, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, paints through a raster SKXamlCanvas, reports a null GRContext, and no longer exposes RaiseOnUnsupported. Adapt code that assumes a GPU context or the old base type; use SKCanvasElement for GPU-backed Uno drawing. The WinAppSDK facade remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Account for physical pixels in GTK4 raster drawing** — SKDrawingArea now exposes physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info by default on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical painting coordinates without reducing backing resolution. RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical, so update coordinate conversion where needed. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source buffer instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Supply well-formed encoded text buffers** — Font text operations now reject negative byte lengths with ArgumentOutOfRangeException and odd GlyphID byte counts with ArgumentException. Supply nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs. StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode requires exactly one encoded unit: use UTF-32 for supplementary code points, UTF-16 for BMP characters, and UTF-8 only for ASCII. GetString now reports null byte arrays with ArgumentNullException. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382), [#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 and upstream correctness fixes** — Updates the bundled renderer to m156. Subsequent syncs reject overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, protect conic-region storage and partial shader pipelines, and add glyph-bounds and raster-allocation guards. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517), [#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575))
- **GPU upload and clipping corrections** — Corrects Ganesh GL's invalid BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration in GLES. Graphite fixes preserve hairline and subpixel stroke bounds, compare complete paint keys, and handle inverse-filled shapes outside the scissor as flood fills. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517), [#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575))

## API Surface

- **GTK4 GPU canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, EnableRenderLoop, and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context and QueueRender invalidates the view. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy; the GPU view does not fall back to a CPU canvas. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux fonts and native-library coexistence** — Restores directory-backed system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies, using /usr/share/fonts by default without fontconfig. Bundled Linux HarfBuzz calls bind locally, preventing incompatible private objects from crossing into a globally loaded system HarfBuzz, such as after GTK initialization. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Display-paced Android rendering** — Automatic continuous texture rendering follows Choreographer display callbacks, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop. Explicit requests remain independent and GL work stays on its worker thread; this does not constrain every RequestRender call or guarantee presentation timing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **WebAssembly linking and archive selection** — Selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11+, retaining 3.1.34 for .NET 8 and 3.1.56 for .NET 9/10. Newer WebGPU consumers use rebuilt archives containing emdawnwebgpu C++ support, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources; JavaScript glue remains a link input. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Correct native boolean callbacks** — Matches Skia callback booleans to one-byte native values and HarfBuzz callbacks to four-byte hb_bool_t values, including false-returning glyph-name callbacks. This addresses Apple ARM64 interpreter return-width issues without changing public managed bool signatures. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Portable Windows native asset selection** — AnyCPU native imports for SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, and WinUI now select x86, x64, and ARM64 assets using win-x86, win-x64, and win-arm64 rather than legacy win10 RIDs. Explicit-platform and empty-RID selection paths remain available. ([#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Respect GTK4 raster buffer ownership** — Disposes the Skia raster surface before the Cairo surface that owns its pixels, retains Cairo's stride, and marks pixel storage dirty after channel swizzling. CanvasSize resets when drawing resources are released. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Bound Windows font and view lifetimes** — DWriteCore custom fonts release application data after the last dependent typeface clone is disposed, while system fonts retain shared-factory behavior. EGL teardown unbinds its own current context before destroying the surface so the native window no longer retains the view. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))
- **Release borrowed stream references** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose that borrowed stream; disposal remains the caller's responsibility. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Fewer temporary allocations** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding storage and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing encoding or decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Refreshed Windows rendering dependencies** — Updates the WinUI ANGLE dependency to chromium/8118 and aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. Native source builds move to Visual Studio 2026 and MSVC v145; these updates do not raise the WinUI project's declared Windows 10 build 17763 minimum. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp reduces allocations in AddUtf32 and feature-string conversion, corrects native boolean callback widths, and aligns WebAssembly archives with .NET 11. Apple and Tizen deployment requirements rise alongside SkiaSharp; package revision 14.4.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. It also aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and moved Tizen packages to Tizen 10.
